courses.title: The Anxiety Programme
courses.description: A self-paced online course of fifteen lessons that looks at anxiety from an energetic point of view. Burgs draws on meditation, chi kung, breathing exercises and energy work for settling into inner stillness and bringing the mind back to a calm, coherent state.

courses.title: Level 2: Healing Meditation
courses.description: The second level of his Art of Meditation training as a self-paced online course of fifteen lessons, following on from the Level 1 foundation. It deepens daily practice and trains the mind towards steadier insight and wellbeing.
